Trigonometry

 Updated August 10, 2026 16:28

You can use Desmos graphing tools to graph trigonometric and inverse trigonometric functions, build interactive unit circles, and create sine wave tracers.
Watch the video for an introduction to trigonometry in Desmos, and read on to learn more.

Radians, Degrees, and Pi Labels

Click Graph Settings and then toggle between Radians or Degrees to better fit your graph.

From the same menu, find Step and then enter pi to display pi labels on the axes.

 Supported Trig Functions

Basic Trig Functions

Function
Try typing...

Sine
sin\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Cosine
cos\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Tangent
tan\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Cosecant
csc\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Secant
sec\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Cotangent
cot\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Inverse Trig Functions

Function
Try typing...

Inverse Sine
arcsin\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Inverse Cosine
arccos\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Inverse Tangent
arctan\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Inverse Cosecant
arccsc\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Inverse Secant
arcsec\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Inverse Cotangent
arccot\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Hyperbolic Trig Functions

Function
Try typing...

Hyperbolic Sine
sinh\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Hyperbolic Cosine
cosh\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Hyperbolic Tangent
tanh\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Hyperbolic Cosecant
csch\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Hyperbolic Secant
sech\(\mathbf{(x)}\)

Hyperbolic Cotangent
coth\(\mathbf{(x)}\)
